race.comment: CANYA KICK IT (2) looks close to another win after finishing third last time (20.07) at Traralgon. Form at the trip excellent including two wins. The form out of last race has been strong. Expected to feature in the finish again. SMART ROSCOE (6) finished well back at Traralgon last time when a 10 length eighth (20.86) but recorded best time of the card when winning five back. Returns to a course where he has performed well. Has ability and can measure up. SIR EASY (5) hit the ground running from out wide with a fast early sectional but run over late and missed the frame when a 3 length fifth (22.36) over 390m at Warrnambool. Deserves plenty of respect. DUSTY DANAE (1) must be respected despite an unplaced effort here most recently.
